usage.callShape: POST https://stableproduct.dev/api/channel3/v0/search with JSON body {"query":"red shoes"} (NOTE: POST, not GET as registry states)
usage.outputShape: Response body is a JSON ARRAY of product objects (not wrapped). Each item: body[].id, body[].title, body[].brands[].name, body[].main_image_url, body[].categories[], body[].price.price, body[].price.currency, body[].availability, body[].best_offer.url (buy link), body[].offers[].{url,domain,price.price,availability}.
quirks: Registry lists method=GET but the endpoint is POST-ONLY. A GET returns HTTP 405 (Allow: OPTIONS, POST). You MUST use POST.
Send a JSON body with at least {"query": "..."}; Content-Type: application/json. Empty {} is also accepted/payable but query is what makes it useful.
Response is a top-level JSON ARRAY of products, not an object with a results field.
Price is fixed 0.01 USDC on Base (eip155:8453 USDC), advertised as 'Varies' in the registry.

Optional advanced params (from the 402 bazaar schema): limit (1-30, default 20), filters{brand_ids,gender,condition,age,price{min_price,max_price},availability,...}, config{language,country,currency,keyword_search_only}, image_url / base64_image for visual search, page_token for pagination.
best_offer.url and offers[].url are trychannel3.com affiliate buy-links (purchase happens off-platform, not via this endpoint).
usage.guide: Call POST https://stableproduct.dev/api/channel3/v0/search (NOT GET — GET returns 405) with header Content-Type: application/json and JSON body {"query":"<search text>"}. x402 will charge 0.01 USDC on Base. The 200 response is a JSON array of product objects; read each product's title, price.price/price.currency, availability, and main_image_url, and use best_offer.url (or offers[].url) as the buy link. This is a read-only product-catalog search — it returns listings/affiliate links and does not place orders, so no approval needed.
